t: 沙赫尔巴拉斯将军手下的萨萨尼德军队征服了泽诺比亚镇.
te: Sassanid troops under general Shahrbaraz conquer the town of Zenobia.
dz: 拜占庭-撒南战争 602–628:沙赫尔巴拉斯将军手下的萨萨尼德军队征服了泽诺比亚镇.
de: Byzantine–Sasanian War of 602–628: Sassanid troops under general Shahrbaraz conquer the town of Zenobia.

t: 在赫拉克利乌斯统治下的赫拉克利安起义的一分舰队"年轻的"到达了君士坦丁堡.
te: A fleet of the Heraclian revolt under Heraclius the Younger reaches Constantinople.
dz: 在赫拉克利乌斯统治下的赫拉克利安起义的一分舰队"年轻的"到达了君士坦丁堡.
de: A fleet of the Heraclian revolt under Heraclius the Younger reaches Constantinople.

t: 希拉克略到达君士坦丁堡，杀死拜占庭皇帝福卡斯，成为皇帝。
te: Heraclius arrives at Constantinople, kills Byzantine Emperor Phocas, and becomes emperor.
dz: 希拉克略到达君士坦丁堡，杀死拜占庭皇帝福卡斯，成为皇帝。
de: Heraclius arrives at Constantinople, kills Byzantine Emperor Phocas, and becomes emperor.
